notes: Classic TSS: Skarmory lays Spikes and Blissey/Swampert absorb hits while Boah Tyranitar punishes the Skarm-Bliss cores that switch into it. Gengar spin-blocks and burns physical threats; Dragon Dance Salamence cleans once Skarmory and the Ice Beam users are worn down.

Zapdos leads and paralyses, Magneton removes Skarmory, then Choice Band Dugtrio traps whichever of Blissey or Tyranitar stands in the way. Once the walls are gone, either Dragon Dance sweeper (Tyranitar or Gyarados) ends it, with Band Metagross as the wallbreaking backup.

Spikes from Skarmory plus phazing from Skarmory and Suicune rack up damage while Blissey and Dusclops status everything. Claydol keeps our side clear of Spikes; Choice Band Tyranitar breaks the opposing walls and Calm Mind + Rest Suicune is the endgame win condition.

Electrode sets rain fast and explodes, then Swift Swim Kingdra, Ludicolo and Gorebyss out-speed and out-damage everything under rain. Zapdos keeps rain up with perfect-accuracy Thunder and Kabutops is the physical rain sweeper that breaks Blissey and Snorlax.

Ninetales sets sun and burns, then Chlorophyll Exeggutor and Victreebel fire Solar Beams and put things to sleep while Charizard's sun-boosted Fire Blast breaks steels. Dugtrio removes Tyranitar to keep sand off the field; Claydol spins and gives a Ground immunity switch-in.

Permanent sandstorm plus Spikes grinds down anything without Leftovers while CurseTar, Registeel and Blissey wall both sides of the spectrum. Claydol spins for us, Gengar spin-blocks and burns for them, and Curse + Rest Tyranitar wins the long game.

Curse + Rest Snorlax is the win condition; Magneton removes Skarmory and Celebi's Heal Bell / Leech Seed keeps Snorlax healthy. Calm Mind Suicune shares the special-wall duty, Choice Band Salamence breaks the physical walls early, and Claydol spins Spikes away.

A full Baton Pass chain: Ninjask passes Speed and Swords Dance, Umbreon Mean Looks a wall and passes Wish, Mr. Mime and Celebi stack Barrier / Calm Mind behind Substitutes. Everything ends up on Zapdos (mixed) or Metagross (physical), which sweep at +6.

Five exploders and an Aerodactyl lead: every Pokemon trades itself for something after doing its job, so the opponent is always down a wall. Cloyster lays Spikes to make each trade profitable, Regice and Exeggutor cripple with Thunder Wave / Sleep Powder before going off, and Aerodactyl cleans the remains.

Skarmory leads, lays Spikes and phazes, Magneton removes the opposing Skarmory, and then Choice Band Tyranitar, Dragon Dance Salamence and Gengar hit hard on a Spiked field. Swampert is the defensive glue that walls Aerodactyl, Metagross and electric attackers.

Jolteon leads, passes Substitutes and forces switches; Choice Band Medicham then punches holes in everything that isn't a Ghost, with Pursuit Tyranitar there to remove Gengar and Dusclops. Dragon Dance Salamence and Agility Metagross clean once Medicham has done the wallbreaking; Swampert is the defensive pivot.

Wish + Calm Mind Jirachi is the special win condition and heals the physical attackers; Choice Band Salamence and Heracross do the wallbreaking. Suicune and Zapdos give sturdy special pivots and Dugtrio traps Blissey / Tyranitar so Jirachi can set up freely.

Zapdos paralyses and Choice Band Tyranitar / Gengar wear down the physical walls so that Substitute + Salac Berry Heracross can Reversal and Megahorn through the endgame. Swampert and Celebi are the defensive backbone; Celebi's Calm Mind is a second late-game win condition.

Spore + Focus Punch Breloom puts something to sleep every game and Milotic / Zapdos wall the special side while Metagross handles physical attackers. Dragon Dance Tyranitar and Choice Band Flygon are the two ways to close out once Breloom has removed a wall.

Dugtrio traps and kills Blissey, Tyranitar and Magneton, after which Calm Mind + Substitute Raikou is nearly unwallable. Skarmory spikes and phazes, Swampert and Celebi are the pivots, and Choice Band Salamence hits whatever Raikou can't.

Starmie spins and keeps up offensive pressure while Skarmory / Calm Mind Blissey form the defensive core. Curse Snorlax and Agility Metagross are the two set-up win conditions, and Choice Band Tyranitar breaks the walls that stop them.

Forretress spikes, spins and explodes; Magneton traps steels so Flygon and Salamence can go to work, and Milotic / Snorlax wall the two attacking sides. Dragon Dance Salamence is the primary win condition with Curse Snorlax as the slow backup.

Trapping stall: Gengar Mean Looks and Perish Songs anything slow, Umbreon Mean Looks and Toxic-stalls walls, and Dugtrio kills the rest of the trappable threats. Skarmory, Blissey and Suicune keep the team alive between traps and Suicune's Calm Mind is the fallback win condition.

Choice Band overload: Aerodactyl, Heracross and Salamence each 2HKO the usual physical walls so no single wall can hold, and Magneton removes Skarmory for all three. Swampert and Gengar provide switch-ins and Gengar's Explosion removes the last obstacle before the sweep.

Leech Seed Ludicolo, Wish Jirachi and Blissey form a healing engine that out-lasts everything while Skarmory's Spikes and phazing do the damage. Claydol spins, Boah Tyranitar breaks the opposing stall cores, and Toxic on three Pokemon guarantees an end to every set-up sweeper.

Offensive Baton Pass: Espeon and Jolteon pass Calm Mind / Substitute while Vaporeon passes Wish and a Substitute to the recipients. Metagross and Salamence take the boosts and sweep physically; Celebi is the emergency recipient and the Heal Bell backbone.

Swords Dance Blaziken and Choice Band Tyranitar are the wallbreakers; Regice, Milotic and Claydol wall the three common attacking types. Substitute Zapdos uses Toxic to wear down Blissey and Swampert so the physical attackers can finish.

Blastoise spins and phazes, Hypno and Nidoqueen wall the two sides, and Swords Dance Gligar / Scyther are the set-up sweepers. Kangaskhan leads with Fake Out and hits neutral targets hard enough to soften walls for the sweepers.

Electrode leads with Taunt and Thunder Wave to cripple leads, then Sharpedo, Nidoking and Typhlosion trade blows nothing in UU can switch into repeatedly. Swords Dance Absol and Kabutops clean the paralysed remains.

Roselia lays Spikes and heals the team with Aromatherapy, Chansey and Quagsire wall the two sides, Weezing burns physical attackers and Misdreavus spin-blocks while Perish-trapping stat boosters. Hitmontop spins for us; the win condition is Toxic + Spikes attrition.

Rain Dance from Electrode, Lanturn and Qwilfish powers three Swift Swim sweepers: Omastar and Ludicolo special, Kabutops physical. Qwilfish also lays Spikes so that the rain sweepers' forced switches add up; Lanturn's Thunder is perfect in rain.

Solrock and Typhlosion set sun, Chlorophyll Vileplume and Victreebel out-speed the tier and put things to sleep, and Arcanine / Rapidash abuse boosted Fire attacks. Extreme Speed Arcanine is the cleaner once the Water-types are asleep or dead.

Scyther passes Swords Dance and Agility, Girafarig passes Calm Mind and Wish, and Plusle passes Agility behind a Substitute. Hitmonlee and Absol sweep with physical boosts, Ampharos with special ones.

Six Explosions: Electrode paralyses or explodes on the lead, Lunatone and Solrock set screens and boom, Muk and Camerupt trade after hitting hard, Golem cleans up. Every Pokemon is meant to take one thing with it, which is more than half the opposing team by turn ten.

Dragon Dance Altaria and Swords Dance Feraligatr are the two set-up sweepers; Manectric paralyses and Blastoise spins to keep them healthy. Scyther and mixed Nidoking apply early pressure so the walls are worn down by the time the sweepers set up.

Calm Mind Clefable and Calm Mind Slowbro are twin bulky set-up win conditions covered by Piloswine's Electric immunity and Crobat's Taunt against opposing walls. Choice Band Fearow leads and Bulk Up Granbull with Heal Bell handles the physical side.

Chansey, Meganium and Dewgong form a three-way wall with Leech Seed and Toxic as the damage sources; Weezing burns and Hazes set-up attempts. Sandslash spins and is the Swords Dance win condition once the opposing team has been Toxic-stalled.

Fast physical offense with Choice Band Tauros and Swellow, backed by the elemental-punch mixed attackers Electabuzz and Magmar who hit everything on the correct side. Golduck's Hypnosis and Calm Mind and Substitute + Salac Primeape are the two late-game win conditions.

Politoed and Ninetales spread sleep and burns, Lanturn paralyses, and Cradily / Misdreavus wall and Perish-trap whatever is left standing. Choice Band Hitmonlee is the wallbreaker that punishes Chansey and the Rock-types once they are statused.

Chimecho's Heal Bell keeps Swords Dance Kingler and Mawile healthy while Sableye walls and Dewgong absorbs special hits. Plusle passes Agility to Kingler or Mawile for the sweep; Sableye's Recover / Toxic is the fallback stall plan.

Cacturne lays Spikes and Leech Seeds, then Raichu, Zangoose and Seviper hit fast and hard from both sides on a Spiked field. Rain Dance Huntail is the surprise sweeper and Hitmontop spins so the physical attackers keep switching in.

Wish Wigglytuff, Recover Sableye and Roselia's Aromatherapy keep the team healthy while Roselia's Spikes and everyone's Toxic wear the opponent down. Torkoal walls physical attackers, Pelipper walls Fighting- and Ground-types, and Rock Head Relicanth is the Double-Edge win condition.

Torkoal and Castform set sun; Chlorophyll Bellossom, Tropius and Sunflora then out-speed the tier with Solar Beam, and Magcargo's Flamethrower doubles in power. Bellossom's Sleep Powder and Torkoal's Explosion open holes for the sweepers.

Pelipper and Dewgong set rain; Swift Swim Huntail, Seaking and Relicanth then out-speed and Surf through everything, with Whiscash cleaning up with rain-boosted Water and Earthquake. Seaking's Megahorn is the answer to the Grass-types that would otherwise stop the rain sweepers.

Glalie lays Spikes and explodes, Nosepass paralyses and explodes, Swalot and Torkoal status then explode, and Metang / Graveler trade with the physical walls. Each Explosion is worth a Pokemon; Spikes make the forced switches pay off in between.

Volbeat passes Tail Glow to Raichu, Ledian passes Swords Dance / Agility and screens, Mawile and Plusle pass Swords Dance and Agility behind Substitutes. Raichu and Kingler are the recipients: +3 special from Volbeat or +2 physical from Mawile ends the game.

Light Ball Pikachu and Choice Band Dodrio lead the pressure, Bulk Up Machoke and Vigoroth muscle through walls, and Haunter explodes on whatever tries to stop them. Arbok's Glare paralyses the fast threats that would otherwise outpace the slow attackers.

Calm Mind Kyogre is the primary win condition, with Soul Dew Latios as the second special sweeper and Groudon there to reset weather and wall physical attackers. Lugia and Blissey absorb hits and spread Toxic; Metagross traps and explodes on the opposing Latios / Latias.

Deoxys leads and fires Psycho Boost / Superpower at whatever is in front of it, then Dragon Dance Rayquaza, Calm Mind Mewtwo and Swords Dance Groudon take turns setting up. Kyogre and Latios cover the Ground / Steel walls that stop Rayquaza and Groudon.

Lugia, Blissey and Skarmory wall the Ubers attackers while Skarmory's Spikes and Toxic on three Pokemon do the damage; Claydol spins and Groudon resets rain. Soul Dew Latias with Calm Mind / Refresh is the win condition once the special attackers are worn down.

Kyogre's permanent rain powers Swift Swim Kingdra and Ludicolo and gives Zapdos a perfect Thunder, while Kabutops is the physical rain sweeper for Blissey. Metagross handles Latios / Latias and explodes on Groudon if it tries to reset the weather.

Groudon's permanent sun makes Ho-Oh's Sacred Fire and Charizard / Moltres' Fire Blasts overwhelming while Chlorophyll Exeggutor fires instant Solar Beams and bulky Venusaur heals 2/3 with Synthesis. Swords Dance Groudon is also the physical win condition once Kyogre has been Solar Beamed.

Deoxys leads with Taunt and Psycho Boost, then Metagross, Regirock, Gengar and Regice each cripple or kill one thing and explode on the next. Calm Mind Mewtwo cleans up a field that has lost its walls to the Explosions.

The OU Baton Pass chain scaled up: Ninjask passes Speed and Swords Dance, Umbreon passes Wish behind Mean Look, Celebi and Mr. Mime stack Calm Mind and Barrier. Rayquaza sweeps with the physical boosts and Mewtwo with the special ones.

Shadow Tag Wobbuffet removes one attacker per game with Counter / Mirror Coat and Encores set-up moves, which is all the space Swords Dance Groudon and Calm Mind Latios need. Kyogre and Ho-Oh cover each other's weather, and Blissey absorbs the special attackers Wobbuffet cannot trap safely.

Standard doubles goodstuff: Zapdos and Gengar (Levitate) sit next to Metagross and Salamence so Earthquake is free, and everything carries Protect to dodge the obvious double-target. Snorlax is the bulky anchor and Explosion from Metagross or Gengar is the trade-off button when behind.

Rain doubles: Ludicolo (Fake Out) and Electrode set rain, then Kingdra, Ludicolo and Kabutops spam Surf and Rock Slide with Water-resistant partners that shrug off the spread damage. Lanturn absorbs Zapdos' Thunder with Volt Absorb and Zapdos' Thunder never misses in rain.

Ninetales and Solrock set sun; Chlorophyll Exeggutor out-speeds the field with Solar Beam and Sleep Powder, bulky Venusaur backs it up with a second Sleep Powder, and Charizard's Heat Wave hits both foes with the sun boost. Arcanine's Helping Hand and Intimidate support whichever sweeper is on the field.

Slowbro or Gardevoir Skill Swaps Truant off Slaking, which then attacks every turn with the highest Attack stat in the game. Zapdos and Metagross keep pressure up while the swap is set up, and Dusclops burns the physical attackers that threaten Slaking.

Clefable's Follow Me redirects everything while Dragon Dance Salamence sets up next to it, and Flygon / Gengar / Salamence are all Earthquake-immune partners for Metagross and Snorlax. Earthquake spam with immune partners is the core damage plan.

Hariyama and Persian Fake Out to buy free turns while Metagross, Golem, Gengar and Camerupt line up Explosions on the two foes. Camerupt's Eruption and Golem's Earthquake next to Gengar (Levitate) are the spread damage before the booms.

Doubles stall: Dusclops burns, Blissey paralyses, Umbreon and Skarmory spread Toxic and Skarmory Whirlwinds boosted attackers out. Everything carries Protect to stall out status damage; Calm Mind Suicune is the win condition once the attackers are crippled.

Kyogre + Latios (Levitate, Water-neutral) and Groudon + Ho-Oh (Flying, sun-boosted Sacred Fire) are the two weather pairs; whichever pair fits the matchup leads. Mewtwo and Lugia are the bulky mid-game pivots with Protect to dodge double-targets.

Rock Slide spam under Tyranitar's sand: Aerodactyl, Tyranitar, Salamence and Metagross all flinch both foes with Rock Slide while Zapdos paralyses to make the flinches land. Swampert is the Electric-immune partner for Zapdos and Earthquakes freely next to Salamence / Aerodactyl.

Lower-tier doubles: Arcanine's Helping Hand and Intimidate support Lanturn / Blastoise Surf spam (both resist the spread damage) and Nidoking's Earthquake next to Altaria and Solrock. Solrock's Explosion and Altaria's Dragon Dance are the two ways to end a game.
